The '''Gandan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the location of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base that was raided by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
